title: Ember Craft - A multiplayer co op dungeon boss running game [browser/no download/keyboard mouse/free]
author: Unhappy_Band_4147
selftext:
Its only for keyboard + mouse

I only use claude code - basically vanilla.  It's running on [babylon js 3D engine](https://www.babylonjs.com/) engine and [colyseus multiplayer framework](https://colyseus.io/). Its deployed on a small Digital Ocean Droplet. I can just push to main and have a deployment github action just deploy on every merge. 

It's kinda supposed to feel like wow controls and combat. It is meant to get people to play together. The point of the whole game is to beat the dungeon bosses.

Let me know what else you want to see in the game. I had one player already get to max level and grind for gear so thats the whole point. The levels have a key system where after you clear it you can re play it harder. The harder the key the more need for more players. The balance needs work I think. 

I am a software engineer for a big tech company but just made this game because I like wow a lot but can't play it due to getting addicted to video games easy. 😂 

The art is all geometric. Not sure i want to commit to any kind of higher level without getting a few people to sign off on the combat feel and gameplay.

Not sure what to use for flair? 

Thinking of adding PVP. WDYT?

Have fun! Leave feedback please
